info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Streaming Subscriptions Billings-v2-spec
info.description: The Streaming Subscriptions Billing API provides access to billing information for active streaming subscriptions. This endpoint allows users to retrieve detailed billing reports, including subscription status, invoiced amounts, and payment history. Typically utilized by billing departments, finance teams, and customer service representatives, this API supports financial audits and customer inquiries. Streamlining the billing process ensures that users can efficiently manage subscription-related finances.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the billing details associated with various subscriptions. It provides insights into payment statuses, billing cycles, and other relevant financial information regarding subscriptions.

requestBody.description: This request body is designed to retrieve billing information related to the subscriptions. Ensure that all required fields are populated correctly to obtain the desired billing details.
